First, note the date format is DD-MM-YYYY: 02-07-1426 (2 July 1426).  
Adding 278 days:  
July 2 + 29 days → July 31 (29 days)  
July 31 + 184 days (days left in 1426 after July 31) = 184 days from July 31 → 1427?  

Let’s compute directly:  
July has 31 days → days in July after July 2 = 29 days (July 3–31).  
278 − 29 = 249 days left to add from August 1, 1426.  

1426 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in Julian calendar? Actually 1426 / 4 = 356.5, so not leap).  
Days from Aug 1 to Dec 31, 1426:  
Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 → 31+30+31+30+31 = 153 days.  

249 − 153 = 96 days left into 1427.  
1427 is common year (1427/4 not integer).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31 → 31+28+31 = 90 days (Jan 1–Mar 31).  
96 − 90 = 6 days into April 1427.  

So April 6, 1427.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1427-04-06
